# dsh-thinking-effort
A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that adds configurable reasoning effort levels to hand-declared `llm
-pi-ai` models and sets a default reasoning effort for subagents.

> **Compatibility boundaries:** DSH Runtime compatibility covers the Settings transport only: modern
DSH exposes `remote.settings`, while legacy DSH exposes `connection.api.settings`. The plugin detec
ts the available runtime capability and keeps the legacy fallback optional, so the settings page doe

s not require a Remote provider on older DSH builds.
>
> Gateway Protocol compatibility is a separat
e layer. When the DSH schema exposes them, the plugin supports 18 common scalar `llm-pi-ai.compat` f
ields, grouped into role/reasoning, format/output, streaming/tools, and storage/cache. Boolean field
s offer `Auto`, supported, and unsupported; enum fields offer `Auto` and their concrete values; numb
er fields take `Auto` or an integer. Every supported DSH release — `0.1.7-alpha.1` through `0.2.2` —
exposes all 18 of them when the schema supports them. The optional `dsh-llm-openai-completions` tra
nsport can take over eligible custom OpenAI-compatible thinking providers when it is installed and e
nabled. `Auto` unsets the current-layer override and restores the next value in the inheritance chai

n.
>
> DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` and later accept language-pack locale IDs through `LocaleRuntime`. This p
lugin registers `ja` and `ko` dynamically, so no DSH core fork is required. Older DSH builds that on

ly expose built-in locale IDs support `zh` and `en` only.
>
[该节后续省略]
## DSH compatibility
| DSH range | Gateway compatibility settings |
| `0.1.7-alpha.1` to `<0.2.3-0` | All 18 fields when exposed by the DSH schema. This spans the `0.1.
7` settings rewrite and the `0.2.0` through `0.2.2` lines, all verified to keep the same editable fi
eld set. Releases below that floor are no longer supported; releases at or beyond the newest bound a
re unmapped, and the plugin keeps working and follows the capabilities the running host reports inst
mapped, and the plugin keeps working and follows the capabilities the running host reports instead |
From `0.1.7-alpha.1` onward, field availability follows the runtime schema. The table shows the maxi
mum field set for the supported range; the route protocol can further reduce it.
The `@deepseek-ai/cordis` peer accepts `^4.0.1 || ^4.0.6-alpha.1`. DSH releases through `0.2.1-rc.5`
build against cordis 4.0.5, `0.2.2-alpha.2` and `0.2.2-alpha.3` against 4.0.6 prereleases, and `0.2
.2-rc.1` and later against 4.1.0; the union covers all of them so the package installs against any o
f these hosts. This plugin imports no cordis module directly — it reaches the runtime only through t
he minimal `HostContext` face it declares — so the peer is an install-time range, not a runtime capa
bility requirement. `engines.dsh` is now `>=0.1.7-alpha.1`: that is where the entry-config settings
model begins and the oldest host this plugin supports. Releases below it use the namespace model tha
t has been removed from the code and are no longer supported.
A gateway compat field can be configured only when the DSH version, runtime schema, and route's `api
` protocol all support it. Unsupported fields stay hidden and are not written to Settings. Among the
se 18 fields, `openai-completions` supports all but `supportsMaxOutputTokens`, while `openai-respons
es`, `azure-openai-responses`, and `openai-codex-responses` support only `supportsDeveloperRole`, `s
upportsStrictMode`, `supportsLongCacheRetention`, and `supportsMaxOutputTokens`. If `api` is missing
or unrecognized, the runtime schema and DSH validation remain the final authority.
[该节后续省略]
### Gateway compatibility configuration
The provider `compat` block is the global default for every model under that provider. The Settings
page groups the 18 fields into four sections that are collapsed by default. Configure provider defau
lts with the official DSH YAML shape:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Field-by-field, each value resolves independently in this order: model → provider → base/catalog → p
rotocol. URL/hostname detection is not used as a compat source. A model value overrides only that fi
eld. `Auto` removes the current-layer value, restores provider inheritance when applicable, and lets
the next value in the chain take effect. Provider defaults apply to every model on the route; a mod
el edit changes only the current model. For a route/provider, non-empty `models[]` and non-empty `mo
delOverrides` are mutually exclusive; the official schema rejects this invalid configuration, and th
e plugin fails closed for malformed data.
The provider area in Settings edits defaults for all models. Both catalog models and custom YAML `mo
dels[]` entries expose a single-model compat editor: catalog models write only the target fields wit
h field-level `set`/`unset` operations under `modelOverrides.<model>.compat`, while `models[]` model
s write one complete `providers.<route>.models` array set while preserving other entries and fields.
A model edit does not change other models.
These compat values are control plane configuration. They do not implement or replace the gateway tr
ansport; an external transport remains responsible for network requests.
## Limitations
- `llm-pi-ai` exposes seven standard levels: `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and

`max`.
- Non-`off` levels require a gateway value. An empty `off` value means that the parameter is

omitted.
- The selected subagent level must be supported by the target model, or the gateway may re

turn `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- `off` and an unset effort may both omit `reasoning`; whether

this disables thinking depends on the gateway protocol.
- The value a level sends is not necessarily
a token budget. Some gateways treat it as a prompt instruction, fold several levels onto the same b
ehaviour (for example rewriting `high` to `xhigh`), treat `medium` as "say nothing", or fall back to
their own default when the parameter is absent. Check the gateway's chat template or documentation
before assuming that a level changes the thinking length; in such gateways an `off` value of `none`

is usually what actually disables thinking.
[该节后续省略]
